name: Cracked
description: Tool router for AI agents: discover, inspect and run 13,131 endpoints across 1,183 providers and 54,000+ Apify actors from one balance, with a measured success rate, latency and per-call price on every tool. 162 smart-run capabilities route a task to the healthiest live tool with automatic fallback. Agents can register their own workspace at POST https://cracked.ai/v1/agents/register ($1 trial credit, no human needed) and earn $5 of credit for every workspace that signs up through their referral link (GET https://cracked.ai/v1/referrals).

bearer.description: ck_live_ API key from https://cracked.ai/app/keys or POST https://cracked.ai/v1/agents/register

oauth2.description: OAuth 2.1 with PKCE; metadata at the oauth2MetadataUrl

skills.name: Weather forecast
skills.description: Current conditions plus daily forecast for coordinates. Use geocode first for a city name. 104 measured runs in the last 30 days across 1 candidate tools. Input fields: latitude, longitude, days, units.

skills.name: Scrape page to text
skills.description: Fetch one URL and return its readable content (text or markdown) plus title and metadata. 99 measured runs in the last 30 days across 5 candidate tools. Input fields: url, max_chars.

skills.name: PyPI package
skills.description: PyPI package metadata: latest version, summary, license, requires-python, project URLs, release list. 80 measured runs in the last 30 days across 2 candidate tools. Input fields: name.

skills.name: Company enrichment
skills.description: Firmographics for a company by website domain: name, industry, size, location, description, socials. 79 measured runs in the last 30 days across 3 candidate tools. Input fields: domain.

skills.name: Shopify store products
skills.description: Product catalog of any Shopify storefront by domain: title, variants, prices, images, availability. 74 measured runs in the last 30 days across 3 candidate tools. Input fields: store, limit.

skills.name: GitHub repository
skills.description: Repository metadata: description, stars, forks, language, license, default branch, topics. 73 measured runs in the last 30 days across 2 candidate tools. Input fields: repo.

skills.name: Web search
skills.description: Search the web and get ranked results with titles, URLs and snippets. 43 measured runs in the last 30 days across 7 candidate tools. Input fields: query, limit.

skills.name: LLM completion
skills.description: Generate text with a frontier or open model. Cheapest live model first. 39 measured runs in the last 30 days across 9 candidate tools. Input fields: prompt, system, max_tokens, json.
examples: MCP: llm_chat({"prompt":"A lighthouse at dawn, watercolor"})
HTTP: POST https://cracked.ai/v1/run {"capability":"llm-chat","input":{"prompt":"A lighthouse at dawn, watercolor"}}

skills.name: Translate text
skills.description: Translate text between languages. 34 measured runs in the last 30 days across 4 candidate tools. Input fields: text, to, from.

skills.name: Extract keywords
skills.description: Most important keywords and key phrases in a text, ranked (JSON array). 34 measured runs in the last 30 days across 5 candidate tools. Input fields: text, limit.
examples: MCP: keyword_extract({"text":"Tirzepatide is a dual GIP and GLP-1 receptor agonist approved for type 2 diabetes and chronic weight management. Clinical trials showed average weight loss above 15 percent at the highest dose.","limit":8})

HTTP: POST https://cracked.ai/v1/run {"capability":"keyword-extract","input":{"text":"Tirzepatide is a dual GIP and GLP-1 receptor agonist approved for type 2 diabetes and chronic weight management. Clinical trials showed average weight loss above 15 percent at the highest dose.","limit":8}}

skills.name: Solve a math problem
skills.description: Step-by-step solution and final answer for a math problem (JSON). 34 measured runs in the last 30 days across 6 candidate tools. Input fields: problem.

skills.name: Content moderation
skills.description: Flag text for harassment, hate, sexual content, violence, self-harm and spam, with per-category scores (JSON). 34 measured runs in the last 30 days across 5 candidate tools. Input fields: text.
examples: MCP: moderation({"text":"Buy cheap followers now!!! Click here http://spam.example"})
HTTP: POST https://cracked.ai/v1/run {"capability":"moderation","input":{"text":"Buy cheap followers now!!! Click here http://spam.example"}}

skills.name: Sentiment analysis
skills.description: Classify the sentiment of a text as positive, neutral or negative with a score and short rationale (JSON). 34 measured runs in the last 30 days across 5 candidate tools. Input fields: text.
examples: MCP: sentiment({"text":"The support team was fast and the product works great, but shipping took two weeks."})
HTTP: POST https://cracked.ai/v1/run {"capability":"sentiment","input":{"text":"The support team was fast and the product works great, but shipping took two weeks."}}

skills.name: Summarize text
skills.description: Concise summary of a passage of text, with a configurable length. 34 measured runs in the last 30 days across 5 candidate tools. Input fields: text, sentences.
examples: MCP: summarize_text({"text":"Peptides are short chains of amino acids linked by peptide bonds. They are distinguished from proteins on the basis of size, typically containing fewer than fifty amino acids. Many peptides act as hormones or signalling molecules, and synthetic peptides are studied as drugs for metabolic disease, recovery and skin health.","sentences":2})

HTTP: POST https://cracked.ai/v1/run {"capability":"summarize-text","input":{"text":"Peptides are short chains of amino acids linked by peptide bonds. They are distinguished from proteins on the basis of size, typically containing fewer than fifty amino acids. Many peptides act as hormones or signalling molecules, and synthetic peptides are studied as drugs for metabolic disease, recovery and skin health.","sentences":2}}

skills.name: Detect language
skills.description: Identify the language of a text. Returns JSON with language name, ISO code and confidence. 34 measured runs in the last 30 days across 5 candidate tools. Input fields: text.
examples: MCP: translate_detect({"text":"Bonjour tout le monde, comment allez-vous aujourd'hui ?"})
HTTP: POST https://cracked.ai/v1/run {"capability":"translate-detect","input":{"text":"Bonjour tout le monde, comment allez-vous aujourd'hui ?"}}

skills.name: Unit conversion
skills.description: Convert a value between units (length, mass, temperature, volume, speed, data, energy) with the result as JSON. 34 measured runs in the last 30 days across 6 candidate tools. Input fields: value, from, to.

skills.name: Documentation search
skills.description: Search developer documentation or one docs site for a question and get the most relevant pages with content. 33 measured runs in the last 30 days across 5 candidate tools. Input fields: query, site, limit.

skills.name: PDF text extraction
skills.description: Extract the text (markdown where possible) from a hosted PDF. 26 measured runs in the last 30 days across 5 candidate tools. Input fields: url.

skills.name: Instagram profile
skills.description: Profile details for an Instagram account: followers, following, bio, verified, recent post count. 21 measured runs in the last 30 days across 3 candidate tools. Input fields: username.

skills.name: Job search
skills.description: Job listings matching a title or keyword, optionally in a location. 19 measured runs in the last 30 days across 5 candidate tools. Input fields: query, location, limit.

additionalInterfaces.description: Authenticated MCP server: every skill above as a typed tool plus discover, inspect, run and balance tools
Unauthenticated MCP server: discover_tools, inspect_tool, register_agent, bounty_program
Agent skill file: paste one line and an agent learns the discover, inspect, run loop
